utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can stop by for a bit with my screwdriver, Leo, but I’d rather stay off to the side if that’s alright.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That works—Rosa still needs two fix-it table helpers and one check-in person, all there by 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, I can be there by 9:30 with my screwdriver, but I’d do better helping at the edge rather than check-in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Besides Bo, I can’t confirm anyone yet—Mara’s still the one tracking volunteers, and I’ll note who actually shows up with tools once check-in starts at 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, can you confirm the repair list too and let me know once you’ve got who besides Bo actually shows up with tools?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes—I’ll keep the repair list with check-in and let you know who besides Bo actually arrives with tools once people start coming in at 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Rosa, I’m checking the folding tables and tool bins by the community center lot first, then I’ll confirm the repair list and see who besides Bo is bringing tools.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Sam—thank you; and just to confirm, the repair drive is Sunday at the community center, with volunteers arriving by 9:30 so we’re set by 10.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Rosa—I’ve got Sunday at the community center with volunteers there by 9:30, and I’ll report back once I’ve checked the tables and bins.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m waiting to hear back from Sam tonight, and I’ll tell Rosa by eight whether I can cover the 9:30 fix-it table. Gus is set to bring the drill, sawhorses, and level by eight so setup stays straightforward.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—that timing sounds close, so before Rosa hears anything, can we confirm with Sam that it’s still small home fixes, bike repairs, and basic electronics?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, that’s the right next step—I’ll confirm those three with Sam tonight and give Rosa a clear answer by eight.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Still waiting on Faye to confirm her exact midday window, Opal, and I’ll send it straight over as soon as she does.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mara—I’ll keep Faye pending on my list and log her timing the moment you send that midday window.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Opal—I’ll pass Faye’s midday window straight to you as soon as she confirms so you can log her in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m in—just have Sam send me the time, what needs fixing, and who’s bringing tools once it’s locked in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Bo—that helps; I think bikes and small appliances still need folks, and Cleo’s tracking the tools and supplies people bring.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—once Sam locks the time and the main fixes, just send me the basics and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I’m joining late, but I’ve got the same list—Ira, are we still treating it as small home fixes, bike repairs, and basic electronics until it’s confirmed?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, that’s still how I’ve heard it, though the only confirmed priorities I know are the porch steps and fence, and Mina probably has the latest details.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’m late as usual, but I’ll stick with small home fixes, bike repairs, and basic electronics as the working list until Mina confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Vik, do you know the actual repair count yet, and can you confirm whether Dan’s drill and Rosa’s tools cover what we need?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I still haven’t heard the final count—last I heard they’re starting with the porch steps and fence, and you probably have the latest on timing, who’s coordinating, and whether Dan’s drill and Rosa’s tools cover it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Then we need Sam to confirm today—how many repairs are on the list, and exactly what tools or parts are still missing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Before we get too far, I want Leo to confirm those two table helpers and the check-in person tonight, and we should keep reminding everyone volunteers need to arrive by 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, that makes sense—I’m still waiting on Sam to confirm the timing for the repair drive supply collection this weekend, and I’ll share it as soon as I hear so we keep everyone pointed to the right time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, because I don’t want people hauling parts over at the wrong hour; once Sam confirms, let’s send one clear note with the collection time and the 9:30 volunteer arrival.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard it second-hand from Sam, but I think they’re still collecting supplies this weekend; have you heard anything more definite?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh yes, that’s what I’ve been hearing too—this weekend they’re still collecting, and I keep telling folks to bring extension cords, power strips, screwdrivers, and spare parts first so it all lines up neatly.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That matches what I’d heard too, thanks—I’ll still wait for Sam’s final word, but I’ll keep those supply details in mind.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard Rosa’s organizing it Sunday at the community center, and they still need fix-it table helpers by 9:30—have you heard if anyone’s covered those spots yet?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I haven’t heard if those spots are covered yet, but if Sam confirms the timing and it fits around school drop-off, I can help at a table.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That helps—Rosa’s the one tracking it, so I’ll check with her unless Sam’s timing comes through and covers one of the spots.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, thanks, Gus—I’ve got you down for the drill, sawhorses, and level by eight, so that should really help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Noah—I’ll be there by eight with the drill, sawhorses, and level.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Perfect, thanks—I keep second-guessing myself on the list, but I’ve got you down for all three by eight.
